quote: Here the glycosyltransferases build lactosylceramide-derived glycosphingolipids and chondroitin sulfate chains
reason: B3GNT5 acts on lactosylceramide (lacto/neolacto series) and CSGALNACT1 initiates chondroitin sulfate, so broadly correct, but attributing both to "lactosylceramide-derived" glycosyltransferase activity blurs; arguable rather than clearly wrong.

quote: the exchange factors VAV1 and FGD3 load them with GTP downstream of antigen and integrin receptors
reason: FGD3 is a Cdc42-specific GEF, not a GEF for RAC2/RHOG/RHOH; also RHOH is an atypical GTPase-deficient, constitutively GTP-bound Rho protein not activated by GEFs.

quote: loss of RAC2 or VAV1 function produces immunodeficiency with defective T cell signalling and neutrophil chemotaxis
reason: RAC2 deficiency causes human immunodeficiency, but human VAV1 loss-of-function immunodeficiency is not an established disease association.

quote: Because activation is transient by design, the abundance of negative regulators is the point rather than an accessory feature, and their disruption drives unchecked motility and invasion.
reason: No evidence in the gene list or name that disruption of these specific RhoGAPs/GDIs causes invasion; speculative mechanism.

quote: too little gives susceptibility to intracellular pathogens, too much gives autoimmunity and inflammatory disease
reason: Disease-outcome framing not derivable from the gene list or curated description; plausible but unsupported specific claim.

quote: Proteasome subunits, SOCS proteins, ZC3H12A and the roquin ligases restrain the response
reason: Proteasome subunits (including immunoproteasome PSMB8/9/10) support antigen processing and NF-κB activation rather than restraining T cell activation; only SOCS, ZC3H12A and roquins are negative regulators.

quote: plus semaphorin–plexin cues that tune contact duration
reason: PLXNA1/SEMA6D are implicated in dendritic cell–T cell interaction, but a specific role in modulating contact duration is not supported by the gene list or curated description.

quote: several of its components are exploited therapeutically
reason: Therapeutic exploitation is not supported by the gene list or curated description.

quote: while GATA3, TBX21 and FOXP3 fix helper lineage identity
reason: FOXP3 specifies regulatory T cells and is a suppressor of effector T cell immunity, not a helper (Th) lineage identity factor; grouping it as positively fixing helper identity is misleading.

quote: cyclin E-CDK2 together with CDC45, GINS and MCM10 converts it into an active replisome
reason: Helicase activation is driven by DDK and CDK (S-phase CDK), but the CMG-forming step is not attributed to cyclin E-CDK2 as the converting kinase in this way; CDK2 activity licenses initiation rather than assembling CDC45/GINS directly.

quote: The same machinery is redeployed in multiciliated cell differentiation through GMNC and MCIDAS, linking origin control to centriole amplification.
reason: GMNC/MCIDAS are geminin-family transcriptional regulators of multiciliogenesis; claiming the replication-initiation machinery is 'redeployed' for centriole amplification goes beyond the gene list and established evidence.

quote: the same signalling logic is exploited to direct pluripotent stem cells toward hepatic and pancreatic fates
reason: Application to stem-cell differentiation protocols is not supported by the gene list or curated description, though plausible.

quote: Its failure produces glucose-galactose malabsorption, renal glycosuria, and the insulin resistance underlying type 2 diabetes.
reason: The first two disease links are established for SLC5A1/SLC5A2, but attributing type 2 diabetes insulin resistance to failure of carbohydrate transport is a causal claim not supported by the name, curated text or gene list.

quote: insulin acting through INSR, IRS1/2, PI3K and AKT2 triggers exocytosis of GLUT4 storage vesicles via RHOQ, STXBP4 and TBC-associated trafficking factors
reason: No TBC-domain Rab-GAP genes (e.g. TBC1D1/TBC1D4) appear in the gene list, so the reference to TBC-associated trafficking factors is not supported here.

quote: Expression is largely restricted to myeloid and mast cells, where receptor signalling through kinases including SYK triggers calcium-dependent enzyme translocation.
reason: Several set members are not myeloid-restricted: PLA2G1B is pancreatic and the GGT family and MGST3/ABCC1 are broadly expressed.

quote: progressively trimmed by gamma-glutamyl transferases to LTD4 and LTE4
reason: GGT/GGT5 converts LTC4 to LTD4; the further step to LTE4 is catalysed by a dipeptidase, not a gamma-glutamyl transferase.

quote: making it the pathway behind asthma and other allergic inflammation and the target of drugs such as zileuton and montelukast
reason: Montelukast is a CysLT1 receptor antagonist and does not target leukotriene biosynthesis; specific disease/drug claims are not supported by the gene list.

quote: the G-quadruplex-resolving helicase DHX36 acts on structured 3' untranslated regions
reason: DHX36 is indeed a G4 helicase, but its acting on 3'UTR structures in 3'-end processing is not supported by the gene set or curated description.

quote: and CCNB1 brings cell-cycle control to bear on transcript maturation
reason: No stated mechanism links cyclin B1 to mRNA 3'-end processing regulation here.

quote: PRMT families are recurrently mutated in developmental syndromes and cancer
reason: PRMTs are arginine methyltransferases, not histone lysine methyltransferases as the sentence's framing implies, and they are not characteristically recurrently mutated in developmental syndromes; they are more often overexpressed.

quote: defects in tRNA and rRNA modification enzymes cause intellectual disability and mitochondrial disease
reason: Specific disease association not derivable from the gene list or curated definition; asserted as a named-disease claim.

quote: This restraint sets tissue sensitivity to circulating hormones and, when lost, permits the unchecked receptor output that drives hormone-dependent breast and prostate cancers.
reason: Specific disease causation claim not derivable from the term or gene list.

quote: Numerous microRNAs tune channel and pump abundance transcriptionally, linking ion flux control to cardiac and neuronal remodelling.
reason: miRNAs act post-transcriptionally (mRNA degradation/translational repression), not transcriptionally.

quote: and chromatin regulation by ZNHIT1 restrains the stem cell programme

quote: Loss of this balance underlies impaired regeneration after injury, defective barrier function, and the crypt hyperplasia that precedes colorectal tumorigenesis.

quote: This route sustains transmission during prolonged or high-frequency firing, when the local vesicle pool would otherwise be exhausted, and it also serves as a sorting station that keeps vesicle proteins and lipids correctly composed.

quote: Defects impair synaptic endurance and neurotransmitter release fidelity.

quote: while CRH, oxytocin, prodynorphin-related and kappa-opioid signalling link drug exposure to stress and aversive withdrawal states
reason: PNOC in the list is prepronociceptin/nociceptin precursor, not prodynorphin (PDYN is absent).

quote: COMT and MAO-adjacent metabolic genes set individual sensitivity, tying this pathway to relapse risk and to dopaminergic neuron identity.

quote: excess or deficient specification distorts the body plan and causes gastrulation failure or cardiac malformation
reason: Specific disease/phenotype outcomes are not supported by the gene list or curated description.

quote: adenosine tone maintained by adenosine deaminase act on endothelium and smooth muscle
reason: ADA degrades adenosine, lowering adenosine tone; loss of ADA raises adenosine and causes priapism, so it does not 'maintain' adenosine signalling.

quote: endothelin receptor B signalling opposes contraction
reason: Endothelin acting via EDNRB on cavernosal smooth muscle is predominantly contractile (vasoconstrictive); only endothelial EDNRB gives NO-mediated relaxation, so the blanket claim is not supported.

quote: activin receptor signalling contributes to tissue remodelling

quote: Lineage-determining transcription factors act reciprocally, so that RUNX3, TBX21, ZBTB7B, BCL6 and FOXP3 each repress alternative helper programmes and enforce mutually exclusive identities, including the choice between CD4 and CD8 lineages during thymic development.

quote: TYR, TYRP1, DCT, PMEL, OCA2 and SLC45A2 build and acidify the melanosome interior
reason: OCA2 and SLC45A2 regulate melanosomal pH by raising it (neutralizing/alkalinizing) to permit tyrosinase activity, not acidifying it.

quote: Because mammalian hair cells are not replaced after damage, the balance struck here determines lifelong auditory sensitivity, and its disruption produces congenital deafness or an abnormal sensory epithelium.
reason: The specific claim of congenital deafness resulting from disruption of these genes is a disease association not supported by the gene list or curated description.

quote: MYCN and MYCL sustain progenitor proliferation before differentiation, while the splicing regulator ESRP1 shapes epithelial identity in the developing otic tissue.
reason: Specific roles for MYCL/MYCN in otic progenitor proliferation and ESRP1 in otic epithelial identity are mechanistic claims not derivable from the set; ESRP1 as a splicing regulator is correct but its otic role is asserted.

quote: This circuitry is the target of efforts to regenerate hair cells.

quote: It matters for hepatic de novo lipogenesis, adipose expansion and membrane lipid supply, and its overactivity underlies fatty liver disease, hypertriglyceridaemia and the lipid phenotypes of metabolic syndrome.
reason: Specific disease attributions (fatty liver disease, hypertriglyceridaemia, metabolic syndrome) are not implied by this GO term's definition or gene list.

quote: while BMPR1A acting through SMAD2/SMAD3 patterns it dorsoventrally
reason: BMPR1A signals via SMAD1/5/8; SMAD2/3 are effectors of TGF-beta/activin/Nodal receptors, not BMPR1A.

quote: Failure here produces axial skeletal malformations, fused or missing vertebrae, and defective body wall closure.

quote: its loss flattens the perception of anything vinegary or citric

quote: but its persistence drives the phenotypic switching that underlies atherosclerotic plaque growth, restenosis after angioplasty, and pulmonary hypertension

reason: RCAN1 is a calcineurin inhibitor rather than a calcineurin-NFAT activating component, so lumping it in as a repressor of contractile genes via NFAT is not supported.

quote: Cells that regulate it poorly missegregate chromosomes and become aneuploid, a route to tumour initiation and to mitotic arrest or death.

reason: Mechanistic claim of a transcriptional threshold role for SIRT1/MEF2C in macrophage apoptosis is not derivable from the provided information.

reason: Direct transcriptional activation of CALB1/UMOD by PAX2/PAX8/POU3F3 is a mechanism not implied by the gene list.

reason: Specific disease associations are not derivable from the gene set or curated GO description.

quote: connexin-40 gap junctions
reason: GJA5 does encode connexin-40, so the naming is correct, but the gene list's only gap junction gene is atrial-restricted; framing is arguable rather than clearly supported for general cell-cell excitation spread.

quote: Imbalance contributes to autoinflammation and interferon-driven disease.
reason: No disease association is provided by the name, curated definition, or gene list.

quote: ornithine and citrulline, made by carbamoyl phosphate synthetase and ornithine transcarbamylase as the nitrogen-carrying core of the urea cycle
reason: OTC consumes ornithine to make citrulline; ornithine is produced by arginase (or from glutamate via ALDH18A1/OAT), not by CPS1/OTC.

quote: hydroxyproline and hydroxylysine, formed by collagen prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases to stabilise the triple helix
reason: The gene set contains only PLOD1-3 (lysyl hydroxylases); no collagen prolyl hydroxylase (P4HA/P3H) gene is present to support hydroxyproline formation.

quote: PON1 riding on HDL where it limits lipoprotein oxidation and is linked to atherosclerosis risk
reason: PON1's HDL association is established, but the atherosclerosis-risk disease link is a specific claim not derivable from the gene set or curated description.

quote: acetylation-dependent control through SIRT1 and KDM1A
reason: KDM1A/LSD1 is a lysine demethylase acting on p53 methylation, not acetylation; SIRT1 is the deacetylase.

quote: cofactor and coactivator input via TAF9 and ZNF385A
reason: ZNF385A (HZF) acts as a p53 target-selectivity cofactor promoting arrest genes, but calling it a coactivator input alongside TAF9 is not established by the listed evidence.

quote: direct restraint of mitochondrial permeabilisation by BCL2 and TRIAP1
reason: BCL2 fits, but TRIAP1 acts via inhibiting apoptosome/caspase-9 activation and cardiolipin/phospholipid transfer, not direct restraint of MOMP.

quote: its tuning explains much of why cancer cells resist chemotherapy and radiation
reason: Specific clinical resistance claim not supported by the gene set or curated definition.

quote: RAB3GAP1 activates Rab3 to govern the vesicle cycle
reason: RAB3GAP1 is the catalytic subunit of Rab3 GTPase-activating protein; it stimulates GTP hydrolysis and thereby inactivates Rab3, not activates it.

quote: the Rho-associated kinases ROCK1 and ROCK2 transmit mechanical tension and actomyosin contractility into profibrotic transcription; calcineurin and RUNX1 couple calcium and injury signals to that program
reason: The specific mechanistic roles assigned to RUNX1 and calcineurin (PPP3CA) in fibrosis signaling are not established by the gene list or curated description.

quote: It sets the threshold that decides infarct size in ischaemic heart and brain, and its suppression lets tumour cells survive the hypoxic cores of solid masses.

reason: ATF2 is included, but characterizing it here as a pro-survival counterbalancing input is not supported; ATF2 can be pro-apoptotic.

quote: Na-K-2Cl and K-Cl cotransporters of the SLC12 family couple potassium entry to sodium and chloride fluxes
reason: K-Cl cotransporters (KCC1-4, SLC12A4-7) normally mediate K+ efflux with Cl-, not potassium entry; only the NKCC/NCC branch imports K+.

quote: sustained activation contributes to psoriasis, inflammatory arthritis and neutrophil-driven tissue damage, while its loss leaves barrier tissues poorly defended against bacterial and fungal infection.
reason: Specific disease associations and infection susceptibility are not derivable from the GO term or gene list.

quote: HFE and related MHC class I-like molecules modulate peptide presentation

quote: Blocking or failing to activate it is what distinguishes latent, therapy-resistant reservoirs from replicating virus.

reason: Specific disease association (NEUROG3 loss causing congenital malabsorptive diarrhoea/neonatal diabetes) is a detailed clinical claim not derivable from the name, curated text, or gene list.

quote: This cascade sits within pancreatic organogenesis and is the template followed when stem cells are directed toward insulin-producing cells in vitro.
